annotation.bound_parties_text: The report addresses the High Contracting Parties to the CCW (e.g., urged to honour financial obligations, pay arrears, and submit national reports on compliance), and the UN Secretariat/ISU.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: urged all High Contracting Parties to honour their financial obligations under Convention.
annotation.dates_quote: At the final plenary session, the Meeting adopted its final report, as contained in document CCW/MSP/2019/CRP.2/Rev.1, as orally amended, to be issued as document CCW/MSP/2019/9.
annotation.robot_provision_quote: The Meeting decided: • To endorse the guiding principles affirmed by the Group, as contained in Annex III of this Report.
